1.he: מדברי המחוקק אליהם בשנית מאגרתו הששית והשביעית
1.note: Probably Paul, 2 Thessalonians 2:15 ('hold the traditions... whether by word or by our epistle'); the numbering 'sixth and seventh' epistle is unclear and is kept as given.

2.he: ראש חכמיהם בספרו נגד אגרת מא"ני
2.note: Almost certainly Augustine, Contra epistulam Manichaei quam vocant fundamenti 5.6 ('I would not believe the Gospel...'), but the author does not name him.

3.note: Idiomatic Aramaic, apparently 'struck it a hundred blows', i.e. refuted it thoroughly; the exact sense of עוכלי is uncertain.

4.he: ויחי אמציהו בן יואש בשנת כ"ז לירבעם בן יואש
4.note: These are two separate verse openings run together (2 Kgs 14:17 and 2 Kgs 15:1), not one quotation.
